_comment: Hosts whose DNS zone belongs to the platform rather than to whoever deploys on it. Owner verification needs a TXT record in the zone, which someone on one of these structurally cannot publish, so the flow is refused rather than offered and then failed. Read by BOTH web/lib/platform.ts and worker/sloptic_web_worker/platform.py: one list, because a suffix the web refuses and the worker honours is the exact gap this closes.
